RP STATED THAT A DRAINAGE DITCH ON SITE WAS IMPACTED BY THE SOLUTION. **RP STATED THERE WAS AN NON-IDENTIFIED 8" PVC CONDUIT PIPE UNDERGROUND THAT WAS NOT LISTED ON THE DIG SITE PLANS WHICH CARRIED THE PRODUCT INTO THE ON-SITE DRAINAGE DITCH.

Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
INFORMATION RECEIVED VIA WEB REPORT: THE BOAT "TOLLY HO" (26 FOOT TOLLY CRAFT) SANK AT APPROXIMATELY 5:00 A.M. ON THE ROCKS AT HOUSE BAY. SALVAGE BEGAN AT 6:00 A.M. AND THE BOAT WITH ADDITIONAL FLOATATION MOVED TO SHORE TO AWAIT LOW TIDE FOR SALVAGE. AT 4:00 A.M. ON 8/6/06 LOW TIDE WAS REACHED AND SALVAGE AND WATER REMOVAL FROM THE BOAT BEGAN. AT 12:00 P.M. THE BOAT WAS DOCKED AT THE ANGOON FERRY TERMINAL AT ANGOON-ADMIRALTY ISLAND-ALASKA. I WILL BE MOVING THE BOAT TO JUNEAU FOR REPAIR. THERE WAS NO HULL BREACH ONLY WATER ACROSS THE REAR OF THE BOAT WHICH CAUSED IT TO SWAMP AND SINK UP TO THE FLY DECK. IT WAS THE LOWEST AND HIGHEST TIDES OF THE MONTH WITH NO MOON. THE TIDE ACTION IN HOOD BAY IS EXTREME AND ALL GASOLINE LOST WOULD HAVE MOVED QUICKLY AND BEEN DISPERSED.
